result.title: Explore with Memory, Learn without It: In-Context Exploration and Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
result.summary: Exploration bounds learning efficiency in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Current methods explore mostly through independent sampling, without fully using the information gathered along the way, such as known wrong answers and environment feedback. We propose LEAF, which injects a dynamic, problem-specific memory into the context before every rollout. The memory contains the most recent response, its reward, and other environment feedback. It is updated after every verifier call. We decouple policy updates from rollouts and update the policy through self-distillation. On four benchmarks and two open models, LEAF accelerates exploration by about 4x compared with a random sampling baseline. On unseen test sets, it improves accuracy over the strongest baseline by 1.59 and 1.83 percentage points on the two models, while using less compute than any RL baseline. These results highlight the potential of LEAF in improving both exploration and learning efficiency. Code is available at: https://github.com/on1262/LEAF

AI.brief_summary: 提出 LEAF：在每次 rollout 前向上下文注入动态、问题级记忆（最近一次回答、奖励及其他验证器反馈），并在每次验证后更新记忆，同时用自蒸馏把策略更新与 rollout 解耦，以加速 RLVR 的探索与学习效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 纯文本 RLVR 工作，不涉及视觉状态，但其「把历史回答与验证反馈作为记忆注入并逐步更新」以及自蒸馏的轨迹训练监督方式，可能为 LVR 中的状态更新、轨迹训练与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索。
